A dorayaki with butter inside, sold only at Isetan Shinjuku. Would you try it? Tokyo's most famous food basement has a whole row of things like this, and most visitors walk straight past them 👇

👀 One of these surprised even us 👉 https://japanbystation.com/isetan-shinjuku-food-hall-what-to-buy

🥞 WOULD YOU TRY IT?

Nakamata, a dorayaki maker from Maebashi, opened its first permanent Tokyo shop in Isetan's basement in 2022. Its fluffy dorayaki with sweet bean paste AND butter is sold only here. Sweet and salty together, best eaten the same day.

⚠️ THE MISTAKE TO AVOID

Expecting free samples everywhere. At Isetan, free tastings happen at events and fairs, not every day. The regular tasting counters (a weekly drink, a spirits tasting at the wine shop, a charcuterie bar) are paid.

✅ WHAT TO DO INSTEAD

1️⃣ Come at 10:00 for the items that sell out.

2️⃣ Check the date: Sasaya Iori's long-roll dorayaki only appears on the 20th to 22nd of each month.

3️⃣ Look for the Kitchen Stage, where guest chefs change the menu every two to three weeks and hand out the recipe.

4️⃣ Take your bento up to the rooftop garden. It's free, and you're allowed to eat there.
